method: Offline gz sdf -p src/erc_description/urdf/tiago_pro.urdf; no simulator launched
parser_note: Declared gz namespace when parsing converted XML; frame contents unchanged.
interpretation: Root base_footprint has no relative pose and coincides with model frame; fixed-joint lumping is expressed in geometry/inertial offsets.
base_footprint_to_base_link_joint_xml:
<joint name="base_footprint_joint" type="fixed">
    <origin rpy="0 0 0" xyz="0 0 0.0762" />
    <child link="base_link" />
    <parent link="base_footprint" />
  </joint>
book_front_reason: Local Z is book depth; spawn uses pitch pi/2. Local -Z face faces the robot. Local X spans book height.
limitations: Confirms nominal description-frame mapping, not live link deformation or synchronized link-pose measurement.
